metric_definitions.cycle_time: S1_APPROACH STEP_STARTED through HOME_END STEP_COMPLETED; failures through terminal event
metric_definitions.clock: node monotonic timestamps; UTC and ROS stamps retained for correlation
metric_definitions.carrier_reposition: Distinct CARRIER_MOTION IDs with max absolute goal-start joint delta > 1e-6 rad; repositions exclude HOME. REQUESTED/ACCEPTED/COMPLETED counted separately. Visual COMPLETED means final joint publication, not controller execution.
metric_definitions.success_rate: 100 * successful_attempts / all_attempts; failures remain in denominator
